name: Dual-saw ladder pad with granular spice and FX macros
goal: Recipe for an ambient/epic pad: two saws (second −12 st, low level), long amp attack/release, ladder/diode filter with slow env→cutoff, corrective low EQ, chorus→synced delay→large reverb, then a granular generator layer with pitch variation; macro cutoff, resonance, FX wet, and granular level.

source.title: Amazing pads with the new Granular Generator in Phase Plant

prerequisites: Synth with ≥2 osc, ladder filter, envelopes, chorus/delay/reverb, optional granular engine, macros

inputs.name: granular_sample
inputs.description: Original sample for grains (optional if engine has sources)

outputs.name: granular_pad
outputs.description: Soft round pad that can turn epic via macros

constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided captions; do not invent UI or settings.
Original synthesis only — map brand UI (Serum/Vital/Pigments/Phase Plant/etc.) to portable osc/filter/FX roles for a browser or generic hybrid synth; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable signal-flow and motion relationships over vendor-specific preset names.
If no granular engine, approximate with a sparsely delayed/pitched noise or particle layer — still keep macros.
Enable polyphonic voice stealing behavior appropriately so new notes don’t hard-cut pads.

steps.action: Two analog saws: second −1 octave at ~20–25% level as low texture; lower master gain.
Ladder/diode filter, low cutoff; second envelope (attack ~2–3s, low sustain, longer decay/release, convex curve) → cutoff for slow open.
steps.expect: Ambient swell; macro can brighten later

steps.action: Corrective EQ: high-pass ~60 Hz; gentle cut ~120–150 Hz mud.
Chorus (e.g. 3 taps, high mix, moderate depth, slow rate) → sync delay (1/4) for chord transitions → large reverb (~35–40% mix).
Add granular layer mid-position, bipolar grain jitter, +12 st, small pitch variation; blend under saws through same FX.
steps.expect: Spicy texture on a round bed

steps.action: Macros: cutoff, resonance, FX wet (chorus/delay/reverb mixes), granular level — start FX mapped from 0 so macro brings space in.

verification: Octave-down saw is quieter than main
Macros move cutoff and FX wet
Granular (or proxy) audible when macro up
